responsibility: Declares the lightweight worklist-driven dead-code removal helper used by other tree SSA optimizers. Its exported interface consumes a bitmap of SSA names whose defining statements may now be dead and performs localized DCE, complementing the full DCE pass implementation in tree-ssa-dce.cc.
same_name_distinction: This header exposes only the lightweight simple_dce_from_worklist entry point for targeted dead-statement cleanup. The complete DCE algorithms, aggressive control-dependence handling, and pass definitions are implemented in gcc/tree-ssa-dce.cc.
